code.text: CHEM

text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows significant hypoxemia (low arterial oxygen saturation and pO2), mild normocytic anemia, leukopenia with neutropenia and lymphopenia, thrombocytopenia, monocytosis and basophilia. Arterial blood gas reveals acidemia (low pH). These findings suggest possible acute or chronic respiratory failure with hypoxemia, and bone marrow suppression or infiltration. Further clinical correlation and urgent evaluation are recommended.
